summary: Macro backdrop for ags: headwind (score -5 across rates, dollar, Brazil real, risk, energy, China, breadth). rates +; dollar −; brl −; risk −; energy −; china −; breadth −. Strongest ag/soft over the month: Rough rice +3.1%; weakest: Lean hogs -16.1%. Key releases ahead: US Core PCE Price Index m/m (11-25 8:30 AM ET); US Prelim GDP q/q (11-25 8:30 AM ET).

sections.title: Rates
sections.text: US 10-year 4.92% (-21 bp in a month), 2-year 4.63% (-18 bp); 2s10s curve +29 bp (-3 bp in a month). Falling yields ease funding costs and support commodity investment flows. T-bill yield 4.12% sets the cost of carrying inventory.

sections.title: Dollar & farm currencies
sections.text: Dollar index 103.93 (+2.1% in a month, +5.7% YTD). A stronger dollar makes US grain, oilseeds, cotton and meat dearer abroad. USD/BRL 5.985 (+18.5% in a month): a weaker real encourages Brazilian farmer selling of soybeans, corn, sugar, coffee and cotton, pressuring world prices. USD/CNY 6.653 (-0.4%); USD/MXN 19.18 (+2.5%).

sections.title: Risk appetite
sections.text: S&P 500 -10.9% in a month (+0.9% YTD); VIX 30.0. Risk-off: funds tend to cut commodity length along with equities.

sections.title: Energy
sections.text: WTI 82.35 $/bbl (-18.4% in a month), Brent 88.71, ULSD 3.809 $/gal (-18.5%), natural gas 3.53 (+0.8%). Lower crude weighs on soybean oil and corn through biofuel margins and on cotton via cheaper polyester.

sections.title: China & industrial demand
sections.text: Copper -15.2% in a month, Shanghai Composite -4.1%, Hang Seng -3.1%, yuan +0.4% vs USD. Soft China/industrial signals point to weaker import demand.

sections.title: Commodity breadth
sections.text: 6 of 33 commodities trade above their 50-day average (18%); S&P GSCI -14.3% in a month; gold -9.7%.

caveat: Directional channels from macro to ag prices are standard relationships, not signals tested on this desk; use as context.

events_ahead.title: Core PCE Price Index m/m
events_ahead.why: Inflation sets rates and real yields; commodities as an inflation hedge
